title: Retinue - public-facing status
text:
Measured 2026-11-12 11:10:00 UTC via gh. All five cards carry this one stamp. The prior stamp was 2026-10-31 22:13 UTC: the daily regeneration did not run for 12 days and was done by hand at this wake-up.

Owner's desk: the 14 issues named on it (chamber#1, 3, 4, 5, 8, 10 and retinue#10, 11, 18, 23, 30, 79, 90, 130) are all over a week old; the oldest, chamber#1 (opened 2026-07-18 22:17:48 UTC), is 117 d 12 h at this stamp. The Mastodon account on chamber#1 is what remains.

Open at this stamp: retinue 19 issues + 10 PRs (all the owner's except bot bump #394), chamber 6 issues, .github 1, qlever-dir 0, ara-android 0 issues + 4 PRs (the owner's). Latest retinue merge #390 (2026-11-11 13:09 UTC). 1 star, 1 fork, 0 outside issues/PRs.
